The push services the project sends through (APNs, FCM): list, set up, turn on or off, delete.

Usage:
  voidhash push config <command> [flags]

Commands:
  list       List the push services the project sends through.
  set        Set up a push service with its credentials, and turn it on.
  enable     Turn a push service back on with its saved credentials.
  disable    Stop sending through a push service, keeping its credentials.
  delete     Delete a push service's credentials.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash push config <command> --help' for more about a command.
